report.explanation: Alert cites checkout error-rate and latency, but current gateway telemetry is largely healthy: error_rate 0.001, p95 77ms, zero dependency timeouts, INFO 200 logs. Only one ERROR span (gateway call inventory, 1017ms) appears, and topology shows gateway->order->inventory, so the failing hop is not directly observed. Evidence is insufficient to establish any bounded root-cause candidate; hand off for downstream service telemetry.
missing_evidence: Traces for order, inventory, payment, and postgresql services during the alert window to localize the error source
Inventory service logs and metrics to explain the ERROR span on gateway->inventory call
Order service metrics (error rate, p95, dependency timeouts) to test downstream-latency hypothesis
Redis and postgresql latency/error telemetry to rule out redis-timeout or db-pool-exhaustion
